name: Top Gun
main_effect: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less. If you have a Digimon in play with 2 or more colors, or with 2 or more colors in its digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 7000 DP or less instead.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
